                  "proposed_facts": [
                    {
                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors\u2014a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.5",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],

                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],

                      "semantic_identity": {}

                    {

                      "reason_codes": [

                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",

                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",

                  "proposed_facts": [
                    {
                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors\u2014a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.5",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board announces new taxes and curfews, and names a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner is hawking hot stew and rumor for coin.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A ragged stranger hangs back, watching the crowd more than the queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {

                  "proposed_facts": [
                    {
                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "authority": "world_truth",

                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",

                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors\u2014a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.5",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"

                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],

                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.1",

                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {

                      "reason_codes": [

                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",

                    },

                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"

                  "proposed_facts": [
                    {
                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors\u2014a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.5",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.",

                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {

                  "proposed_facts": [
                    {
                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors\u2014a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.5",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board announces new taxes and curfews, and names a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner is hawking hot stew and rumor for coin.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",

                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {

                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                  "proposed_facts": [
                    {
                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors\u2014a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.5",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board announces new taxes and curfews, and names a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner is hawking hot stew and rumor for coin.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {

                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],

                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",

                      "consequence": "consequential",

                      "reason_codes": [

                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",

                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {

                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",

                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                    },
                    {

                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },

                  "proposed_facts": [
                    {
                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",

                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",

                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",

                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      ],

                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",

                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors\u2014a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [

                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.5",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.",

                    },

                  "proposed_facts": [
                    {
                      "text": "The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.visible_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors\u2014a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.opening_seed_facts.5",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.0",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.1",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A notice board announces new taxes and curfews, and names a missing patrol.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.2",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {
                      "text": "A tavern runner is hawking hot stew and rumor for coin.",
                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.3",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
                      "semantic_identity": {}
                    },
                    {

                      "provenance": "authored_world_fact",
                      "consequence": "consequential",
                      "authorized": true,
                      "reason_codes": [
                        "authored_state_source"
                      ],
                      "authority": "world_truth",
                      "persistence": "world_truth",
                      "source_ref": "scene.journal_seed_facts.4",
                      "outcome_classification": "established_or_retrieved",
